claimChecks.claim: Corona mortis is only an aberrant arterial vessel in 20-30% with a fixed Cooper's safe distance
claimChecks.locator: Original systematic-review PDF definition and pooled Table 2
claimChecks.note: Arterial/venous connections recognized; 45.55% pooled estimate across 1455 hemipelves with severe heterogeneity, not a patient-specific safe zone.

claimChecks.claim: Accessory pudendal vessels occur in 10-15% and inadvertent sacrifice causes erectile dysfunction
claimChecks.note: Prevalence depends on detection method; pooled 28.5% in meta-analysis, no significant adjusted ED association in one cohort; preservation still desirable when feasible.

claimChecks.claim: Blind retropubic sling passage plus cystoscopy is a complete safety recipe
claimChecks.note: Removed blind instruction, retained cystoscopy for urinary-tract integrity; major vessel and bowel safety not inferred.
